snapshot_author_gate.value: approved author list, or at least 80,000 AAVE proposition power

snapshot_threshold_aave.note: If the 320,000 AAVE threshold is met, the proposal proceeds to the AIP stage; if not, it fails. A quorum failure may reopen the Snapshot vote once.

onchain_creation_threshold.note: NOT STATED in the current official docs: the on-chain proposal-creation threshold is described only as 'sufficient proposal power'. The V2 planned configuration was 0.5% (Short Executor) / 2% (Long Executor) of supply (secondary source C-AAVE-V2-CONFIG).

level1_voting_delay_days.note: Short Executor (Level 1): 1-day voting delay, 3-day voting period, 1-day timelock, 7-day grace period.

level1_quorum_aave.note: At least 320,000 must participate AND the winning option must receive at least 320,000 votes.

level1_vote_differential_aave.note: ARFC framework: YAE votes must exceed the second-largest option (NAY or ABSTAIN) by at least 80,000.

level2_voting_period_days.note: Long Executor (Level 2): 10-day voting period, 7-day timelock, higher quorum and vote differential.

level2_quorum.note: NOT STATED in the current official docs ('higher quorum and vote differential' only). V2 planned configuration: quorum 20%, vote differential 15%, proposition threshold 2% (secondary source C-AAVE-V2-CONFIG). The 2022 Level 2 update needed about 900,000 AAVE to pass (C-AAVE-L2RFC).

level2_proposition_power_aave.note: 2022 Level 2 update: 320,000 AAVE proposition delegation required to create the proposal, and it had to be maintained for the 17-day vote + queue period or anyone could cancel it.

voting_power.value: AAVE + stkAAVE + aAAVE balances on Ethereum Mainnet, validated on the voting network with storage proofs

voting_networks.value: Polygon PoS, Avalanche C-Chain, Ethereum Mainnet (backup)

execution.value: any address may call executePayload() on the PayloadsController after the timelock expires

proposal_maintenance.value: proposition power must be maintained; below-threshold proposals can be cancelled by anyone

protocol_emergency_guardian.value: 4-of-7 multisig; holds EMERGENCY_ADMIN in Aave V3; can pause markets and act in a protocol emergency
protocol_emergency_guardian.note: Signers published in the official docs.

governance_emergency_guardian.value: 5-of-9 multisig; can cancel malicious or erroneous governance proposals
governance_emergency_guardian.note: Signers published in the official docs; cancellations typically follow Certora verification review.

freezing_steward.value: can freeze a reserve immediately; cannot unfreeze (requires governance)

risk_steward.value: bounded parameter changes (e.g. LTV/LT/LB max 0.5% absolute, 72h delay); cannot set caps/LTV/LT/bonus to zero or act on restricted assets

finance_stewards.value: Aave Finance Committee 2-of-3 multisig 0x22740deBa78d5a0c24C58C740e3715ec29de1bFa; treasury swaps only into DAO-whitelisted tokens, within per-token budgets; proceeds return to the Collector

gho_stewards.value: GHO Steward v2, four contracts; 1-day timelock and maximum change per update; operated by the GHO Risk Council multisig

executed_proposal.title: Adjust Level 2 requirements (long-executor)
executed_proposal.outcome: Approved on Snapshot with 325,000 AAVE votes; implemented via on-chain proposals created through an Autonomous Proposal contract
executed_proposal.note: The update replaced the Level 2 Executor and the AAVE ecosystem reserve implementation. Creation used an Autonomous Proposal smart contract (0x6E1A6728829BC0FcA82C1A39834c6212C250F1c1) that accumulated 320,000 AAVE proposition power. About 900,000 AAVE were required to pass the Level 2 proposal.

check_notes.A1-1: Snapshot author gate (80,000 AAVE) is public; the on-chain creation threshold is not stated in the current docs.
check_notes.A1-3: No built-in autonomous-proposal path; a one-off autonomous contract was built for the 2022 Level 2 update.
check_notes.A6-1: Level 2 quorum and vote-differential exact values are not stated in the current docs.
check_notes.A6-2: Governance contract addresses are linked from the docs but were not verified from a primary source at audit time.
